speaker: Daniel
text: But there has also been the downside because of those not-so-pleasant experiences. In Indonesia, a boy menaced me, assuming I was willing to pay for his company. In Japan, I was picked up by a young man who refused to drop me at my youth hostel; he insisted I stay with his friends. The friends turned out to be four girls. I was safe, but one snored like a lawnmower, and it took me two days to escape.
